title: cyclosorus basilaris
intro: Cyclosorus basilaris, commonly known as the Rattlesnake Fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to tropical regions of Asia and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Cyclosorus basilaris include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit antioxidant activity, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
